notes.text: sap.m.Title: visual test is now linked to control
sap.m.Input: Description is now alignable to the right via the new descriptionAlign property
sap.m.Dialog: reserve vertical scrollbar space via scrollbar-gutter
sap.m.Popover: Stay open on resize while opener is in the viewport
sap.m.Select: Announce items with VoiceOver on macOS Chrome
sap.m.Title: Enhanced Tooltip and Extended Keyboard Navigation enablement
sap.m.Table: Align ClearAll icon with the checkboxes
sap.m.Select: support grouped items via SeparatorItem
sap.m.DateTimePicker: Clocks visibility after toggleInputMode on phone
We've now fixed the accessibility and the re-rendering issues in the ImageContent control
Table: Selection Limit Popover heading level should be H1
sap.m.Link: fixed outlines of focused Link border in HC themes
We've now fixed the MIME type mismatch error by ensuring that the mediaTypes are stored with the original case to avoid case-insensitive comparison in UploadSetwithTable
sap.m.PlanningCalendar: fixed date/time/weeks header in narrow screen width
Calendar related controls focus management for mobile devices accessed by keyboard
sap.m.ColorPalette: announce color count in palette region labels
